comparison.objective: Reconnect a parted joint in a rod line; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Rod-end alignment and joint mating versus recessed tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, stabilization, and set-screw locking.
comparison.success_condition: Rod line is physically continuous at the repaired joint versus two compliant carriage stops with retained setting. No task specs are available beyond the short body.
comparison.reason: Joint splicing tests alignment and connection, not iterative damping calibration.
